label: OVHcloud infrastructure connector
summary: Map selected OVHcloud projects and regional infrastructure resources to authorized Core operation plans.
core_boundary: OVHcloud-specific topology and credential constraints stay in the connector; local server administration is not gated by this package. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Select and pin one reviewed product/API profile rather than assuming all OVHcloud products behave identically.
Verify project, region, instance and volume ownership before any action is proposed or dispatched.
Exercise request expiry, credential rotation, provider outages and safe reconciliation after partial provisioning.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
